rows.grounds: genitive dependent indicating the deity before whom worship occurs
locative used adverbially to mark position before the sun
name of the charioteer of the sun, subject of worship
particle adding further objects of worship
particle marking sequence in the ritual instruction
compound with ādi indicating a group beginning with Vidhvā
celestial deities included as objects of worship

items.question: Which figures must be worshipped in front of the sun deity in this ritual sequence?
premises: Aruṇa is designated as worshippable in front of the sun.
Vidhvā and other planets are included as worshippable figures.
The instruction continues the sequence of ritual placements.
items.inference: Therefore, Aruṇa and the planets beginning with Vidhvā are to be worshipped in front of the sun.
uncertainties: The specific identity of Vidhvā among the grahas is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: In front of the sun, Aruṇa is to be worshipped, and then also the planets beginning with Vidhvā.
